channel.title: GoodAIPromt
channel.description: A free AI prompt library for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney and AI video tools. Fill in the blanks, copy the prompt, get better answers. New prompts daily.

item.title: ChatGPT prompts for accountants: tax season emails
item.description: Write a tax season email series for accounting clients, from document checklist to deadline reminders, in a clear and calm firm voice.

item.title: After-hours support auto-reply prompt
item.description: Write after-hours and holiday support auto-replies for email, chat and SMS that set clear response times, offer self-help and route urgent issues.

item.title: Antique shop marketing prompt
item.description: Market an antique shop or vintage mall with item story posts, new-arrival alerts, collector email lists, event ideas and online listing copy that sells.

item.title: App icon design image prompt
item.description: Generate app icon concepts that read at small sizes, with one bold symbol, a strong color and a rounded-square layout, shown on a home screen mockup.

item.title: App promo video with a phone mockup prompt
item.description: Create a short app promo video with a floating phone mockup, smooth camera moves and screen-safe framing for app store previews, ads and launch posts.

item.title: Local SEO plan prompt for appliance repair companies
item.description: Build a local SEO plan for an appliance repair business, with service and brand-agnostic pages, Google Business Profile fixes and review steps.

item.title: ChatGPT prompts for art teachers: lesson plans
item.description: Plan an elementary art lesson with a clear objective, artist link, materials list, step-by-step demo, differentiation and a simple rubric.

item.title: Membership drive campaign for associations
item.description: Plan a membership drive for an association or club with segment value props, email and social copy, a referral offer and renewal reminders.

item.title: Astronaut AI art prompt for surreal scenes
item.description: Create surreal astronaut AI art, from an astronaut in a flower field to one floating in a flooded city, with clear mood, light and composition.

item.title: Aurora borealis AI image prompt for night skies
item.description: Generate realistic northern lights landscapes with believable aurora colors, a strong foreground, reflections and night photography settings.

item.title: Auto detailing business marketing prompt
item.description: Plan auto detailing promotions with package names, seasonal offers, before-and-after post captions and rebooking messages for repeat clients.

item.title: Autumn forest AI video prompt
item.description: Generate a cozy autumn forest AI video with falling leaves, golden light, mist and a slow camera move, for fall reels, intros and ambient loops.

item.title: Backorder notice email prompt for online stores
item.description: Write a backorder notice email that tells customers the new ship date, their options (wait, swap or refund) and how to choose in one click.

item.title: BANT lead qualification questions and scoring
item.description: Get natural BANT discovery questions for budget, authority, need and timing, plus a simple lead scoring sheet and next steps for each score.

item.title: Bed and breakfast marketing plan prompt
item.description: Build a bed and breakfast marketing plan with a guest profile, direct booking copy, local packages, email ideas and review replies that fill rooms.

item.title: Bike shop marketing prompt for every season
item.description: Plan bike shop marketing by season, with service tune-up campaigns, group ride posts, winter storage offers and emails that bring riders back.

item.title: Bowling alley marketing ideas prompt

item.title: Brand SERP audit prompt for your company name
item.description: Audit what Google shows when people search your brand name, find weak or negative results and get an action plan to improve your brand SERP.

item.title: Campground and RV park marketing prompt
item.description: Plan campground and RV park marketing with site descriptions, direct booking copy, shoulder-season offers, rules messaging and guest emails.

item.title: Capability statement for government contracts

item.title: Car rental business plan prompt

item.title: Cherry blossom AI image prompt for spring scenes
item.description: Generate cherry blossom images with soft pink trees, a clear setting, falling petals and gentle light, in photo or illustration style.

item.title: Clothing boutique marketing plan prompt

item.title: 529 college savings plan prompt

item.title: Competitive benchmarking report with scorecard

item.title: Conference talk proposal (CFP) that gets accepted

item.title: Credit union marketing prompt for new members

item.title: CSAT survey questions prompt

item.title: Data quality checks for any dataset

item.title: Desert sand dunes AI video prompt
item.description: Generate a cinematic desert sand dunes AI video with wind-blown sand, golden light, camel caravans or a lone traveller, and smooth drone moves.

item.title: Workplace dress code policy prompt

item.title: ChatGPT prompts for driving instructors: lessons
